about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established company within Malta's automotive industry, for an experienced and motivated Workshop Assistant Manager to support the daily running of its automotive workshop in Gżira.

Working alongside the Workshop Manager, you will help oversee workshop activity, supervise technicians, plan schedules and make sure every repair and service is completed to manufacturer standards and on time. You will also be a point of contact for customers who need updates on their vehicle.

The role suits someone with strong technical knowledge of automotive repairs, proven leadership skills and a real commitment to operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. It is a full-time, on-site position with a competitive salary, health insurance and employee discounts.
responsibilities: Assist in managing daily workshop operations, keeping workflow and productivity efficient
Monitor technician performance, repair times and compliance with manufacturer standards and procedures
Plan and coordinate workshop schedules, allocating resources to minimise vehicle turnaround times
Ensure repairs and services are completed within agreed timeframes and quality standards
Monitor warranty procedures and coordinate warranty claims with the relevant departments
Work with the Parts and Warranty departments so that parts and accessories are available on time
Run daily progress meetings and report operational issues or delays to the Workshop Manager
Oversee workshop tools and equipment, including maintenance, servicing and calibration
Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including correct use of protective equipment
Handle customer enquiries and complaints professionally and give updates on repair progress
Make sure customer approval is obtained before additional repairs or services are carried out
Review job cards, work-in-progress records and technician reports for accuracy
Apply quality control procedures and final inspections, and carry out test drives with customers when needed
Promote a first-time-right approach to repairs and continuous improvement
Maintain technician training records and identify professional development opportunities
Work with the Service Reception team on accurate invoicing and clear customer communication
requirements: Previous experience in a similar workshop management or supervisory role within the automotive industry
Good technical understanding of automotive repairs, servicing and workshop operations
Computer literacy and the ability to work with workshop management systems
Strong organisational, planning and time-management skills
Leadership skills, with the ability to motivate and coordinate a team of technicians
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
A customer-focused approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure
Good teamwork skills and a proactive, hands-on attitude

faq: What does a Workshop Assistant Manager do?

You support the Workshop Manager in running the automotive workshop: supervising technicians, planning schedules, checking repair quality and times, coordinating parts and warranty work, and keeping customers updated on their vehicles.
Is a salary stated for this role?
The careers page does not give a figure; the role offers a competitive salary, plus health insurance and employee discounts.
How much experience do I need?
You need previous experience in a similar workshop management or supervisory role within the automotive industry, with a good technical understanding of repairs, servicing and workshop operations.
A minimum A-Level standard of education is required, together with computer literacy and the ability to use workshop management systems.
Is this role remote or on-site?
It is a full-time, on-site role at the workshop in Gżira, Malta.
